title: Mercury Meaning
overview: Mercury describes the mind in motion: thought, language, questions, interpretation, learning, writing, conversation, and the way information becomes useful. It shows how someone notices patterns, names what is happening, and makes decisions from what they observe.
cycle: Mercury moves through all twelve signs in roughly a year, with retrograde periods that slow down communication, review, and decision-making. Its sign describes the style of thinking; its house shows where the mind stays busy.

signs.body: With Mercury in Aries, your communication is direct, assertive, and enthusiastic. You think on your feet, making you a natural problem-solver. You tackle intellectual challenges with boldness and excitement.

With Mercury in Taurus, your communication style is measured, grounded, and practical. You think things through thoroughly before voicing your opinions, and your words are typically well - considered and reliable.

With Mercury in Gemini, you're quick-witted and express thoughts eloquently. Skilled in conversation, you're always ready to exchange ideas. Your adaptable and curious mind enjoys exploring multiple subjects.

With Mercury in Cancer, your thinking process is greatly influenced by your emotions. Your communication is intuitive, nurturing, and often indirect. You excel in understanding and conveying emotional subtleties.

With Mercury in Leo, your communication style is bold, creative, and confident. You're good at expressing your thoughts in dramatic and compelling ways. You enjoy being the center of attention, engaging others with your vivacious and charismatic speech.

With Mercury in Virgo, your thoughts are analytical, detailed, and practical. You excel at problem - solving and critical thinking. You communicate clearly, logically, and you're good at giving useful advice.

With Mercury in Libra, your thinking process is balanced, diplomatic, and harmonious. You excel in mediating and finding fair solutions in conversations. You enjoy intellectual exchanges that involve give - and - take.
With Mercury in Scorpio, your communication is intense, probing, and insightful. You uncover truths and dig into deep topics, preferring meaningful conversations over small talk.

With Mercury in Sagittarius, your communication is optimistic, broad-minded, and sincere. You're a seeker of knowledge, engaging in philosophical and thought-provoking conversations. Your expression is open and honest.

With Mercury in Capricorn, your communication is clear, organized, and serious. You're good at strategic thinking and planning. Your words are chosen carefully and are often laced with practical wisdom.

With Mercury in Aquarius, your thinking is innovative, idealistic, and somewhat unconventional. You enjoy intellectual exchanges about progressive ideas. You have the ability to communicate your unique ideas effectively.

With Mercury in Pisces, your communication is empathetic, imaginative, and intuitive. Your thinking process is often influenced by your feelings. You're good at expressing ideas creatively and understanding others on an emotional level.

source.title: As Above, So Below: A Guide to Astrology for Tarot Readers
